results.title: AGent Energy Closes Series Seed to Unlock 200+ GW of Behind-the-Meter Generation Across Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional Sectors
results.author: AGent Energy
highlights:
HOUSTON, Aug. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AGent Energy, a trailblazing developer of AI-driven distributed power plants, today announced it has closed an $11 million Series Seed financing co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, with participation from Intrepid Investment Management and existing investors CIV and Zero Infinity Partners (ZIP). The round follows a $6 million financing from CIV and ZIP, which closed within two months of founding, bringing AGent's total funding to $17 million in its first 12 months. It's a striking vote of confidence in behind-the-meter generation as the next great frontier of U.S. energy infrastructure.

results.title: AGent Energy Raises $11 Million To Unlock 200+ GW Of Idle Behind-The-Meter Power
results.author: Amit Chowdhry
highlights:
AGent Energy has raised $11 million in Series Seed funding to scale its AI-driven distributed power plant platform and pursue more than 200 GW of behind-the-meter generation capacity across commercial, industrial, and institutional facilities. The round was co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, with participation from Intrepid Investment Management and existing investors CIV and Zero Infinity Partners.
...
The financing follows an earlier $6 million round from CIV and Zero Infinity Partners that closed within two months of AGent’s founding. The company has now raised $17 million during its first 12 months.

The new round was reported on August 13, 2026, and lifts reported total funding to $17M. AGent did not publicly disclose a valuation, detailed financing terms, or a precise use-of-proceeds allocation in the sources reviewed by DevCuration. That absence matters because early-stage capital often arrives wrapped in a fog machine of assumptions; here, the verified story is strong enough without inventing what management did not announce.

results.title: Tech VC funding: AGent Energy, Medicare Platform, Skan AI - InfotechLead
results.author: Thasniya V P
highlights:
AGent Energy Raises $11 Million to Unlock Over 200 GW of Distributed Power
...
AGent Energy raised $11 million in Series Seed financing co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, with Intrepid Investment Management, CIV and Zero Infinity Partners participating. The Houston company has secured $17 million during its first 12 months, including a $6 million round completed within two months of founding. Its AI platform aggregates, dispatches and monetises backup generators at commercial, industrial, municipal, university, school, hospital and data-centre sites. AGent targets more than 200 GW of behind-the-meter generation and already operates across PJM, MISO and ERCOT, including during grid emergencies. Funding will expand its team and deployment. Spero’s Stephen Wemple joins the board, while MassMutual Ventures’ Aram Ouligian becomes a board observer. Asset owners receive revenue without paying upfront capital costs.
